items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: The tail end of them, Jamille — he changed his name, he’s got a Muslim name now but his daddy was a Humphrey.

ctx.x: The Humphrey family, no. Not specifically.

Nobody told you about the Humphrey family? The Humphrey family was one of them old families. They had a lot of musicians come out of there. The tail end of them, Jamille — he changed his name, he’s got a Muslim name now but his daddy was a Humphrey. His daddy’s mama was a Humphrey. Daddy was a very good trumpet player, he played with Lionel Hampton and played with M. Red Thompson was his name before he got to be Sharif. He played lead with Lionel Hampton and solo. He’s the first person that told me about Clifford…
